description: Hand-written synthetic Interactive Editorial Dialogue answers (Issue #52, S17a) layered over sample1-baseline-happy, so J-16's analyses read exactly as before. One question, 这段的叙述视角是否一致？, is answered under unit ordinal 0 by the dialogue contract's request digest: asked (and asked again by 重新回答) it streams five text deltas, the second ending in the middle of a sentence and the last with no end mark; continued from a stopped answer it streams the two sentences that answer left. The words are the fixture's own and quote nothing of the Book.
